notes.title: 1.04 Released
notes.content:
1.04 has been released!! Massive Content Patch!!

Added 16 maps, we're now up to 35 available!

Fixed building road and boats on shallow water interaction, this allows road building and boat building to be alot more smooth.

notes.title: 1.02 Released!!
